summary: Frontend-only E2E of the new SHARE feature across web + mobile Expo web preview. All requested share entry points render, are clickable/tappable, do not crash, and (where a sharer is authenticated) produce a URL containing ?ref=<handle>. InviteBanner logic verified: shows for LOGGED-OUT visitors on /directory/seed_rigging, on the event modal at /events?event=seed_ev_2, on /community-hub/<id>, and on Landing with ?ref=Jane (bottom-floating), showing 'JANE INVITED YOU TO SAIL MORE NOW'; hidden when the same routes are visited by a logged-in user. Web-share fallbacks verified: with navigator.share stubbed the share sheet callback receives the correct URL (e.g. https://.../directory/seed_rigging?ref=salishmarinaservices when logged-in); with navigator.share undefined the clipboard fallback runs and a 'Link copied — share it anywhere' toast is shown. Mobile Community Hub verified end-to-end: Feed header hub-btn → /hub; hub-tab-forum / hub-tab-blog toggle correctly; opened hub-card-<id> → /hub/[id] (body + comments), added a comment via hub-comment-input + hub-comment-send-btn; compose via hub-compose-fab → /hub/new; forum publish inserted a discussion with status='published' (immediately visible at top of /hub); blog publish inserted a discussion with status='pending' (submitted for review — verified in MongoDB). Mobile share entry points present + no crash on tap: event-share-btn (events/[id]), pro-share-btn (directory/[id]), hub-share-btn (hub/[id]), refer-friend-row (Profile). Parity: web + mobile both expose share for events, Boat Pros, forum, blog, and refer-a-friend. No red screen. Only remaining console noise: repeated 'shadow*' RN-Web deprecation warning (pre-existing from iteration_55/56, non-blocking).

react_native_issues.issue: Repeated RN-Web deprecation warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Pre-existing since iteration_55; non-blocking, no functional impact on share/hub flows.

action_items: OPTIONAL / low priority: On /hub/new, after Alert.alert('Submitted for review',...) the code calls router.back(); when the screen is reached via deep-link (no history) Expo Router emits 'The action GO_BACK was not handled by any navigator.' This is not user-visible in the normal fab→/hub/new path, but consider `router.canGoBack() ? router.back() : router.replace('/hub')` for robustness.
OPTIONAL: RN-Web `shadow*` → `boxShadow` migration (carried over from iteration_55/56 — still open, unrelated to this feature).
critical_code_review_comments: ShareButton.jsx / share.js: Correctly falls back to clipboard when navigator.share is unavailable, and shows a 'Link copied' toast; AbortError path returns 'cancelled' without falling through to clipboard, which is correct UX.

InviteBanner.jsx: Correctly gated on !user, and reads ?ref via useSearchParams — verified personalization ('JANE INVITED YOU TO SAIL MORE NOW') on both /directory/seed_rigging?ref=Jane and /?ref=Jane.
mobile/src/lib/share.ts: buildShareUrl uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL which is the WEB host — recipients open a public web page (not a broken mobile-only deep link), matching the requirement.

Anti-pattern to flag (not blocking): when a logged-out user hits the share buttons on web, no ?ref= is appended (ref = user?.handle||user?.name||null). This is expected behavior but worth confirming with product — the current output URL for an anonymous sharer is a plain link with no attribution.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all requested share testIDs render + are functional on web and mobile; InviteBanner personalization + logged-in/out gating verified; Community Hub forum-immediate vs blog-pending publish flows verified against MongoDB.

test_credentials: Web cookie session_token = 'test_session_web_1788984209939' (seed_marina). Mobile Bearer session_token = 'test_session_mobile_1788984258189' (seed_marina). Both seeded fresh into test_database.user_sessions for this run.
seed_data_creation: Inserted 2 user_sessions rows (web + mobile). Created 2 discussions via the mobile compose flow: forum 'TEST Forum share-agent' (id 9b0207a6-…, status=published) and blog 'TEST Blog share-agent' (id 7abd16cf-…, status=pending). Also added 1 comment on discussion af1e2a96-... ('TEST hub comment share-agent'). Cleanup NOT performed — main agent may prune TEST_* rows if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Every share feature and the mobile Community Hub work end-to-end on both surfaces. Auth-seeding pattern that worked: (web) page.context.add_cookies([{name:'session_token', value:<token>, domain:'boat-community.preview.emergentagent.com', path:'/', secure:true}]) BEFORE goto; (mobile) page.add_init_script("window.localStorage.setItem('session_token', JSON.stringify('<TOKEN>'))") BEFORE goto. On RN-Web, Alert.alert renders as an in-app modal, NOT a browser dialog — Playwright's page.on('dialog',...) does not fire; assert via post-conditions instead (e.g. DB rows, page URL after navigate, or a visible confirmation string in body). For share URL assertion on web, stub navigator.share (or set to undefined) and navigator.clipboard.writeText, then read window.__shared / window.__copied after clicking the share button.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues found. Only observation: /hub/new emits an Expo Router 'GO_BACK was not handled' warning when reached by direct URL rather than via the compose FAB, because router.back() has no history to pop after Alert.alert. In-app flow (Feed → hub → compose-fab → new) does have history and works correctly.
